set.body:
Need (storyatlas4s Recall Voyage, 2026-09-03): the reference page draws a group-level anchor as a
rounded bar (`rx`) and its stat tiles as rounded cards; `Grob.Rect` emits a bare `<rect>`
(SvgRenderer.scala:362) with no radius, so the lowering drew polygons instead.

Proposal: `Grob.rect(..., radius: Length = Length.zero)` (or `rx`/`ry` as `Length`s), emitted as
`rx`/`ry` by the SVG backend and drawn as a rounded path by Canvas, Java2D and JavaFX; radius in
the same unit family as stroke widths so device-pixel radii survive scaling.

Acceptance:
- a zero radius renders byte-identically to today;
- conformance: the rounded rect's bounding box equals the sharp one's; all backends draw it;
- laws: negative or non-finite radius refused at construction.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.x][Scene] Rounded rectangles: a corner radius on Grob.Rect
